notes: Full description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs LintRunner::lints() at line 493 and LintRunner::bundle_version() at line 498-500 are missing #[must_use]. The crate has #![warn(missing_docs)] but there is no lint for missing #[must_use] on pure accessor methods. Since lints() returns a slice reference and bundle_version() returns &'static str, calling these methods for their side effects is meaningless — they should be #[must_use]. Also: EvaluationReport::has_findings() at report.rs:126, EvaluationReport::findings_at_or_above() at report.rs:135, and DeviationStore::all() at deviation.rs:449, DeviationStore::active_at() at deviation.rs:454, DeviationStore::active_for_lint() at deviation.rs:461, DeviationStore::expired_at() at deviation.rs:474 all lack #[must_use] despite being pure read-only methods. Fix: Add #[must_use] to these accessor methods. Priority: P3 (API hygiene; compiler doesn't warn without it).
title: FINDING (duplicate/covered by PKIX-m75.16): LintRunner::lints() missing #[must_use]
